value.rationale: The universal binary-cubic discriminant is a canonical classical family. A natural degree-six Jacobian structure changes its reduced support from a twisted cubic to a line in characteristic three; the exact conductor and Frobenius map quantitatively describe the inseparable degeneration. The difference between finite-field/étale invariants and coherent H² is a substantive structural consequence rather than an arbitrary isolated computation.
